## Checklist

- [ ] `cmake --workflow --preset check` and `check-msvc` pass locally (`cppchk`)
- [ ] Tooling, build or dependency change → ADR in `docs/adr/` (project-only decision → `projects/<name>/docs/adr/`)
- [ ] Docs updated where behaviour changed (`AGENTS.md`, `docs/`)
- [ ] No planned or unimplemented project mentioned, no personal paths or machine names
- [ ] Clang-tidy suppressions name the check and give a reason
